tei:div.tei:p: (153)snyan brgyud thig le bcu drug las/ khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i sgrubs thabs bzhugs/ (154)

thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ bkod pa bsam mi khyab pa'i thig le ru/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi byin brlabs zhing*/ byang chub sems 'byong 'phags bod bstan pa spel/ chos kyi sgron me a ti sha la 'dud/ lha chos rin chen bdun gyis rnam thar gyis/ gangs ljongs bstan pa snyigs ma gtsang por mjad/ bshes gnyen 'brom rje de sras sku mched gsum/ bka' gdams brgyud pa rnams la phyag byas te/ de las brgyud pa thig le bcu drug las/ bcu pa khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i/ rang gi dge ba'i skal pa mi dman pas/ rim pa 'di ni bshad pa shes par mjod/ 'dir mnyam med jo bo yab sras la brgyud pa'i man ngag gsum mnga' ba'i 'dir nyams len byin brlabs kyi brgyud pa phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan nas rim par byung ba 'di nyams su len pa'i gang zag kyang*/ mi gzhi bzang ba tshul khrims gtsang seng nge ba tshe 'di blos thong ba mi gral nas bu dong shes pa/ rang 'dod kyis 'khris med pa/ lus lha bzhi sems bslab pa rin po che gsum gyis brgyan pa zhig gis nyams su len 'os zhing*/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ chos 'di bstan pa'i gnad bshad nyon/ nga dang khyod la zhe thag pa'i/ ngur smrig gos kyis lus brgyan la/ rnam thar snying po snying du len/ 'dul ba bzhin du tshul (155) khrims bsrungs/ mdo sde bzhin du lhag bsam sbyong*/ mngon pa bzhin du lhag shes rgyas/ gzhi ma ma 'chug tshul khrims gtsang*/ lam sna ma 'chug tshad med 'gro 'bras bu mi 'chug 'tshang rgya ba'i/ skyes bu de ni 'di bstan yul/ zhes gsungs pas/ de'i dgongs pa zhal gzigs kyi tshom las/ 'brom gyis zhal nas/ dbang gi rgyal po nga la gson/ gang dag rgyun du mchod byas nas/ 'chi khar dbugs ni len pa mthong*/ de 'dra'i lha ngan 'dre bas brtsegs/ mchod 'phro nyid nas bstung bar rigs/ de bas phyi ma ngan 'gror 'dren/ mchod bstod nongs pa gcig gis 'joms/

rdor legs po dkar sogs pa/ don med 'gong pos dgos pa med/ rtag tu dngos grub ster ba'i lha/ bde gshes rgyu las rab 'khrung zhing*/ bcom ldan gang gis mi g.yo mgon/ lha yang 'di nyid chos skyong nyid/ phrin las thams cad rab sgrub gsol/ ji srid bstan pa ma brlag par/ g.yo bar mi mjad srung zhing skyobs/ zhes gsungs pas/ de nyams su len pa lha bzhi 'dams nga'i le'u las/ lhag par sgron mas 'di skad gsungs/ rgyal ba'i sras ni spyan ras gzigs/ khyed kyis rjes 'brang kho mos skyol/ kho mo'i gdams pa 'di long la/ rjes su 'brang la (156) bstan par gyis/ skyabs gnas bla ma dran par mjod/ lus ni lha yi rang bzhin te/ ngag ni bzlas brjod rgyun par mjod/ 'gro ba ma lus pha mar bsam/ sems kyis gnas lugs stong bar spyod/ lnga po de yi rkya bar nas/ dge rtsa thams cad dag par mjod/ gsung pa bzhin rtsa ba'i sa bcad kyi rim pa lngas bsdus nas thig le bcu drug cig rdzogs su nyams su len pa dang*/ re re nas nyams su blangs pa gnyis las 'dir ni phyi ma ltar 'chad pa'i/ dang po skyabs gnas bla ma dran pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ snyigs ma'i dus na thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis par gyur pa dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin mnyam med jo bo yab sras mkhyen no/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po mkhyen no/ byang chub sems kyis rgyud 'byong zhing rnam thar gtsang mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba mjad pa mkhyen no/ thos pa blo bde ba mkhyen no/ bsten pas 'di phyir 'tshing ba mkhyen no/ skyabs na bslu mi srid pa mkhyen no/ gnod byed la khog mi khro ba mkhyen no/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab dam par gyur pa mkhyen no/ paṇa chen lnga bcu'i gtsug (157)gi nor bu rin po che mkhyen no/ ye shes sgron ma chen pos gangs can gyis bstan pa'i mi ro gzhi bzheng su slong ba khyed mkhyen no/

dmu sgod kyi gdul bya nyes spyod chen po'i g.yeng ba las skyobs pa mkhyen no/ brgyud pa gsum gyis man ngag gi bdud rtsis skal ldan smin par mjad pa mkhyen no/ blal ma sangs rgyas rin po ches bdag smin par mjad du gsol/ sgrol bar mjad du gsol/ blo sna mang la 'dod thag nye ba bdag skyabs tu gsol/ chos mang du thos kyang chos dang gang zag rgyab 'gal po bdag skyabs du gsol/ skye shi mngon du gyur kyang rtag 'jin phyi tshes can bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du go yang khyim gyi tsho 'jin la rem pa bdag la skyabs du gsol/ rgyu 'bras zhib cha go yang sdig pa la nyin mtshan med par spyod pa bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ tshul khrims gtsang ma dam pa'i rnam thar yin par go yang bslabs pa ngos lkog gyi g.yo sgyu can bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ ting nge 'jin rnam rtog gis g.yengs la skur ba (158)bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ shes rab bden 'jin gyis blo dang 'dres pa bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ bdag 'dod kyis rtog pas byang chub gyi sems rgyang gi bsgyur ba bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ mi 'dod dgu 'dod la sangs rgyas thob pa'i re ba med pa bdag la skyabs tu gsaul/ mchog gsum la yid mi ches zhing 'dre ngan la re ltos 'cha' ba bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ snyom las le lo'i bdud kyis khyer ba bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ kha chos dang lag len don 'jol po bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ rang gi chos ma nus pa gzhan la gyod brdal po bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ ma rig pas rang mgo 'thum nas rang gi skyon la yon tan du rlom nas gzhan skyon rgyun du gleng ba'i shes med po bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ chos la yang skyed bton kyang yon tan la blo skye med pa bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ chos nyon mongs pas rang rgyud gong bur 'dril ba skyon du ma shes pa bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ sems 'di dge ba la 'gro mim 'dod pa sdig pa 'gogs du med pa blo ngan po las ngan po bdag skyabs tu gsol/

zhes gsol btab po/ (159) gnyis pa lha rjes su dran pa ni/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bla ma rdo rje 'jin pa chen po/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzungs te ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi'o/ zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ lan gsum/ skyabs su song nas/ phyogs bcu na sogs dgongs gsol gyis/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi'o/ dbugs ma dbyung rnams dbyung bar bgyi'o/ yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba rnams 'da' bar bgyi'o/ lan gsum gyis sems bskyed nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi lus lha rjes su dran pa (160) dngos ni/ stong gsum dang mi mjed gcig dang rang gi gnas khang dang bcas pa thig le re re nas bsgom par gsung kyang*/ 'dir ni rjes dran gcig la tshangs par ston pas/ oṃ swā bha wa shuddho sogs/ zhes brjod pas/ snod bcud thams cad stong par bsam/ de'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid thig le dkar po gsal la rtog pa med pa/ shel gyi sgong nga'am/ 'od kyis rnam pa hril hril pa/ bskyed na sprul pa ma lus pa bskyed par nus pa/ glod na rang bzhin gyis dbyings su yal te 'gro ba gcig bsgom/ de rgya je che 'phang je mthor song bas stong gsum mi mjed kyi thig le ngo bo lha rnam pa lha de nyid dang dbyer med pa thugs rje chen po dang thub pa'i dbang po sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i dkar la ser ba'i mdangs chags pa/

nang 'od kyis gzhal yas khang steng dkar po oṃ gyi rnam pa/ shar ser po ma'i rnam pa/ lho dkar po'i ṇi'i rnam pa/ nub sngon po pad kyi rnam pa/ byang ljang gu me'i rnam pa/ 'og gzhi dkar pa hūm̐ gi rnam par snang ba/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab la sogs pas spras pa/ phyi nas nang gsal/ nang nas phyi gsal ba'i dbus su paṃ dkar po las padma dkar po dang*/ (161)a dkarapo las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du yi ge hrī dkar po tsheg drag can gcig tu gyur pa de las/ rang gi gnas khang dbu ru sa yi thig le/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen bhrūm̐ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas su gsal ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed spros zhing sdud pa'i 'byung gnas khye'u dkar po bzheng pa'i sku can/ zhal 'jum zhing cung zad 'gying ba'i stabs can/ chu shel gyi gong bu phyes pa 'dra ba'i dwangs pa/ dbu skra mthing ka dpung mgo gnyis na mar nyil le ba tsam sprug smug po sku la gsol dar skyer kha'i sku rag can/ phyag g.yas na nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba bsgrang ba/ g.yon na shel gyi mkhar ba dkar po bzungs bar/ mkhar ba'i rtser padma dkar po 'dabs ma stong du gyes pa/ de'i lte ba ser po la zla ba'i gdan de'i steng na yum chen mo/ g.yas na mar me mjad/ g.yon na shākya thub pa gnyis ngo bo gcig la rnam par tha dad par bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma stong la sangs rgyas stong*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs (162)rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams kyang 'khod pa bdag gis sna drang te 'gro drug thams cacad gtso bo la skor ba byed cacing ma ṇi 'ur gyi bsgrang zhing*/ de rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros te bdag la thim thim 'jug pas sgrib pa sbyong bar bsam la sngags cung zad bzla'o/ de ltar bsnyen pa dang bskor ba byas pas gtso bo de mnyes te/ thugs ka'i sgo phye bas nang nas 'od zer cig byung bas drangs te gtso bo'i 'kho rnams dang bdag gis gtsos 'gro drug thams cad phyir ma lus pa nang du zhugs pas/

'phags pa'i thugs kar saṃ dkar po las padma dkar po dang*/ a dkar po las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing ka las mi g.yo ba sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan mar ba gnyis kyi gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i bsdig mjub/ zhabs g.yas bskul g.yon brkyang ba stag gi shams thabs can mi dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa khro bo du ma'i 'khor du bsam mo/ de nas gtso 'khor de dag gi gnas gsum yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer (163)'phros pas bdag gi gtsos 'gro drug der 'khod pa thams cad kyi sgo gsum la phog pas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag lus shes sgong ltar sgrib pa med pa gsal bar gyur pa'i phyogs thams cad 'ja' tshon gyis gur du 'khrigs pa'i gnas der rang gzhan thams cad 'phags pa gsang ba'i bdag po sngon po lag na rtags kyi rdo rje'i dbang phyug pa bsnam pa bsam pa'i rang rang gi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru las 'od zer spros pa'i sna las mchod pa'i sprin phung rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bas mi g.yo ba sras bcas mchod par bsam la/ phyag dang phyag yul gnyis stong ba'i/ rnam dag sku la ye phyag 'tshal/ skye gnas 'jigs pas ma gos pa'i/ dri med mchod tshogs 'bul lo lha/ sgo gsum skye gnas 'jigs bral ba'i/ nyes pa'i g.yeng ba mthol lo bshags/ stong kyang sna tshogs skur ston pa'i/ grangs med 'dren la rjes yi rangs/ smon dang mtshan mas stong ba yi/ 'khor lo dbyings su bskor du gsol/ skye bas stong pa'i chos sku khyod/ lhun grub gnas pa'i rang bzhin (164)las/ gang du'ang 'da' bar ma mjad cig dge ba 'di yis 'khor ba rnams/ 'di 'dra rtogs te 'di 'dra ba'i/ gzhal yas khang du 'dongs gyur te/ gsang sngags de bzhin spyod par bsngo/ gzhan yang ji snyed su dag sogs/ lha tshogs rnams gsal la rang bzhin me da pa la dmigs pa rtse gcig pas/ mthing 'jams sprin gyi gur gseb nas/

mthing mdog khro bo du ma rnams/ brkyang bskum gar gyis bdud sde skrag 'jum chags gar gyis bdag gis bstod/ zhes brjod nas yon tan dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas mnyam par bzhag go gsum pa ngag sngags rjes su dran pa ni/ rang gzhan 'gro ba thams cad lhar dmigs pa'i ngang nas gtso bo la bskor ba byed cing sngags bzla ba dang chab gcig gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pas sngags bzla ba dang gnas gsum gyis yig 'bru gsum gyis 'od zer bdag sogs la thim pas sgrib pa sbyang gtso bo'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam la/ snying po oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa ces pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i sngags bzla'o/ de las dmigs bsal la/ lha dang rang gzhan thams cad lhar gsal bas sngags 'ur gyis bzlas shing*/ bstan pa dang bdag la gang gnod pa nyal nyal (165)bcom par bsam la/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa bstan pa dang 'gro ba la srung shig srung shig oṃ spho ṭa spho ṭa ma hā kro dha tsha ti spho ta la hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ tsaṇḍa la hā ro ṣa ṇa bstan pa la gnod par byed pa'i snying la mā ra ya jaḥjaḥ.a ti thuṃ thuṃ rbad rbad shag shag tshil tshil tsitta zung tsitta shig dhaṃ daṃ tshig sa mā ya phya/ snying sa ma ya phya/ kro he he snying la gzer/ oṃ duḥkha gcod pa phye/ oṃ spho ṭa spho ṭa ma hā kro ta tsha ti spho ṭa ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces shin tu drag po'i sngags kyang nyung ngur bzla'o/ bzhi pa 'gro drug ma lus pha mar bsam pa ni/ de ltar rjes dran thams cad kyi dus su 'gro drug pha mar dran pa'i snying rje shas mi bzod pa kam kam bskyed dgos te/ de'i tshul zhus lan las/ blo ldan snying rje chen po nga la gson/ nga yi pha ma la la me yis tshig nga yi pha ma la la mtshon gyis gshag nga yi pha ma la la srin bu'i zos/ ngi yi pha ma la la kha twas zos/ nga yi pha ma la la khro chur bying*/ sdug bsngal ma bzod thang la bros gyur kyang*/ thang cen spu gris gtam pa'i lam du song*/

de la'ang rab tu skrag te bros gyur (166)pas/ bsil nags 'khrugs te ral gri rab tu snyil/ gzhan yang gos med grang bas rab tu gdung*/ a chu rab tu chu bur rab tu rdol/ padma ltar gas utpal bzhin du gas/ da ris nga yi pha ma de 'dra na/ mi gcig pha ma me dong lhung gyur na/ snying yod mi bzod snyams la 'phar rtse na/ nga yi pha ma de 'dra bzod lags sam/ nga yi pha ma gos med skom pa dag zas med mgrin phra lto ba rab tu che/ yan lag phra zhing stobs med gyur pa rnams/ ji ltar bzod dam 'brom rje de la som/ gti mug gyur pa'i pha mar bltas na yang*/ dbang med bzod dka'i sdug bsngal rnams kyis gtses/ phal tsher rang sha dgra bor lang pas phung*/ la la spu lpags sha rus dgra bor lang*/ la la rang stobs khur chen dgra bor la/ la la mgyogs pas bkol te dgra bor lang*/ la la dbang med 'byung bzhis brdung bar gyur/ pha ma de 'dra bzod dam 'brom rje som/ e ma mtho ris bde skyid zhes grags pa/ drang por skye ba'i lus ni rgur por gyur/ nag song skyes pa'i skra ni dkar por gyur/ dkar por dmar mdangs 'jam zhing gnyer med pa/ sngo skam gnyer ma la (167)sogs dag tu nyams/ kun gyis yid kar mi 'ong pha rol nye/ bskyang ba'i bus kyang sdang mig lta bar byed/ de yang mi rtag pha rol 'gro ba sogs/ bzod dam snying nas de la bsam par rigs/ 'brel glags med de 'khor ba ma stong bar/ pha ma'i don du jo bo bskyang du gsol/

zhes ngag nas ci thon du 'don zhing lha la gsol ba gdab po/ lnga pa sems gyi gnas lugs stong par spyod pa ni/ yang snga ma bzhin gtso bo'i thugs kar zhugs pas pad zla'i gdan snga ma bas rgya che la dpang mtho ba/ bkod pa sa bcu'i 'phags pas kyang rtogs par dka' zhing*/ yid du 'ong zhing mjes pa'i gzhal yas khang dbang bcu dang stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ngo bo chos kyi sku dang dbyer med pa/ de'i dbus su bdag nyid sangs rgyas chos kyi sku zag pa med pa'i ye shes can rnam pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i skyil krung dang mnyam bzhag gis bzhugs pa ser po yon tan gyi chos ma lus par mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'jin la mnyam par bzhag nas/ thams cad 'bad med lhun grub rtsol bral chen pa'i (168)ngang la gnas par lta'o/ de'i ngang las sprul sku du ma 'phros nas gzhal yas khang der gnas par bsam mo/ de nas rang gi snying dbus su thig le ser po dwangs ba yungs 'bru tsam gcig bsgom/ de rgya je che je cher song nas nor bu rin po che'i snod rgya che ba dpangs mtho ba shin tu dngas shing 'od 'tsher bar bsam/ de'i nang du rang sems thig le ser po sran ma tsam dngas shing 'od 'tsher ba gsal ba/ mer mer g.yo zhing 'ju ba lta bu rgya je cher song nas thig le rgya mtsho chen po gser gtso ma'i mdog ltar dwangs shing khod snyom pa gzhi brtan pa nam mkha' ma brlag bar du gnas pa/ rgya che ba nam mkha' dang mnyams pa/ khyab che ba skye 'phags yongs la khyab pa me long dwangs ba'i ngos ltar gzugs brnyan thams cad 'char ba cig bsgoms la mnyam par bzhag de'i rjes la rjes dran snga ma'i lha dang gzhal yas khang rnams rang gi kha dog gi thig ler gyur nas rim gyis phyi ma rnams nang ma la thim ste mthar rdo rje 'chang gi bar rnams spros pa dang bral ba'i thig le gcig tu 'dres nas sran ma tsam du gyur pa de rang gi spyi bo'i oṃ (169)la thim/

de mgrin pa'i āḥ de thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de byang chub sems kyi thig le la thim/ de stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i thig le gsal la rtog pa'i ngang la thim par bsam la mnyam par bzhag go de nas skyo na slar yang byang chub sems kyi thig le ser po yungs 'bru tsam las snod dang*/ sran ma tsam las bcud kyi rgya mtsho bskyad pa gong ltar gsal btab la/ stong nyid dang snying rje dbyer med kyi ngang de las thig le dkar po cig byung nas de las spyan ras gzigs su gyur te/ byang chub sems kyi thig le rgya mtsho gser btso ma'i maṇḍal phyis pa ltar dngas la de'i steng du rgyan bkod pa ltar bzhugs nas/ rgyan dang rgyan can gcig gi gzugs brnyan gcig la 'char ltar dngas par bsgom la rjes kyi spyod lam 'jug par bya'o/ de ltar dngos gzhi rjes dran lnga po gang gi skabs su yang snang la rang bzhin med pa stong la der zhe bral ba sgyu ma dang rmi lam gyis dpe mtshon nas bdag med bdag snang gi rgyud la nyes pa byung tshad 'bur 'jom gyis gsung po/ gsum (170) pa rjes la/ bla ma rdo rje 'jin pa rnams/ ye shes thugs rjes thog med pas/ rdo rje 'jin pa dgongs su gsol/ thabs dang shes rab mchog ldan pa'i/ dbang dang bskyed rjogs zung 'jug chos/ dus gsum spyad pa dkyil 'khor 'dir/ khyed kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs slad du/ mchog gi mchog tu bsngo bar bgyi/ ji srid nam mkha' ma brlag par/ rdo rje 'jin dang lhan cig tu/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rab bskor zhing*/ dngos grub gnyis dang ldan par shog snod rnams lha yi gzhal yas te/ bcud rnams lha dang lha mo la/ ma dag snang ba yod ma gyur/ thabs shes gnyis kyis 'da' bar shog phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ bla ma rnams dang dbyer med par/ byang chub sems dpa' bdag la dgongs/ ji srid nam mkhas khyab gyur pa/ gnas pa'i pha ma ma drin can rnams/

smon dang 'jug sems stobs ldan pa'i/ tshogs gnyis dus gsum spyad pa rnams/ rtse cig sems la rab bsdus nas/ sa bcu bsgrod nas mi slob par/ gzhan don lhun gyis grub par bsngo/ ces dang*/ rdzogs sangs (171)rgyas sku la thob par/ mtho ris dbang po mchog gis brgyan/ skye rga na 'chi mi 'khrugs par/ tshogs gnyis rtag tu gom par shog la sogs pas smon lam gdab/ dge ba gang byas lam 'gro ba'i/ bkra shis rin chen mchog tu shog lam bzang zin nas mi ldog pa'i/ brtan pa'i bkra shis rgyas par shog 'gro ba gang gi don dag tu/ de 'dren chos ston shis par shog spyod lam 'di nas bzungs byas nas/ spyod lam ci byed dge ba yis/ gzhan gyi mig 'dren phun tshogs las/ chos grogs bkra shis 'phel bar shog bkra shis 'di nas rab bzung nas/ mthar thug bkra shis ma thob par/ bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i 'gro 'dren pa'i/ bshes gnyen mchog gi bkra shis shog 'khor ba stong par ma gyur pa/ nga nyid lham me lhan ne dpal/ nam mkha' lta bur khyab gyur te/ thar ba'i sgo 'byed bkra shis shog ces brjod la me tog gi char du bsnyil lo/ jo bo yab sras sku mched rnam pa gsum/ rin chen bdun ldan brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bar/ spros med ngang nas zab don thig le rnams/ yi ge med par (172)dbyings su sgrub par mjad/ de bzhin yi ge med la yi ge'i gzugs/ deng 'dir mi snang sgra brnyan bral bas na/ chos dbyings thig le 'jal bas dben gyis dgos/ snyan brgyud zab mo gsang ba'i yi ger bkod/ bka' rgyas btab pa'i gtan tshig ma mthong min/ snying gi thig le rtsis mdo 'dor min yang*/ deng seng bcu drug cha yi re re nas/ nyams len byed rlom ji bzhin shes pa min/ stong gsum mi 'jed lha dang gzhal yas khang*/ rang gi gnas lus 'phags pa'i skur gsal zhing*/ de'i thugs kar chos sku'i nyams len gsum/ gcig tu 'gril ba jo bo'i bzhed pa yin/

de phyir rjes dran lnga yi man ngag gis/ sbas don snyan brgyud mi ger bkod pa la/ bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro dam tshig can/ bka' sdod 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis bzod mjod rigs/ 'di phyir sgrib pa'i nyes par mi 'gyur zhing*/ snang stong sgyu ma'i thig le 'di zhugs nas/ stong nyid snying rje'i gom pa mthar phyin nas/ rgyal ba yab sras rjes su 'jin gyur cig// /
